integrityChecks.label: 用户计数（球员≥1, 场地方≥1）
integrityChecks.sql: SELECT user_type, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM users GROUP BY user_type
integrityChecks.detail: 球员≥1, 场地方≥1 → 实际: 球员=2000, 场地方=1

integrityChecks.label: Player→User 引用完整性
integrityChecks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as orphan FROM players p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id IS NULL
integrityChecks.detail: 0 孤立记录 → 实际: 0 孤立记录

integrityChecks.label: MatchPlayer→Match+Player 引用完整性
integrityChecks.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) as orphan FROM match_players mp
      LEFT JOIN matches m ON mp.match_id = m.id
      LEFT JOIN players p ON mp.player_id = p.id
      WHERE m.id IS NULL OR p.id IS NULL
integrityChecks.detail: 0 孤立记录 → 实际: 0 孤立记录

integrityChecks.label: 比赛状态一致性
integrityChecks.sql:
SELECT m.id, m.status, m.required_players,
      COUNT(mp.id) as actual_players,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN mp.status = 'confirmed' THEN 1 END) as confirmed_count
      FROM matches m
      LEFT JOIN match_players mp ON mp.match_id = m.id
      GROUP BY m.id, m.status, m.required_players
integrityChecks.detail: 0 异常 → 实际: 101 场比赛, 0 异常

integrityChecks.label: 支付订单完整性（confirmed 球员都有 paid 订单）
integrityChecks.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) as missing FROM match_players mp
      LEFT JOIN mock_orders o ON mp.match_id = o.match_id AND mp.player_id = o.player_id
      WHERE mp.status = 'confirmed' AND (o.order_no IS NULL OR o.status != 'paid')
integrityChecks.detail: 0 缺失 → 实际: 0 缺失

integrityChecks.label: MatchPlayer→Intention 引用完整性
integrityChecks.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) as orphan FROM match_players mp
      LEFT JOIN intentions i ON mp.intention_id = i.id
      WHERE mp.intention_id IS NOT NULL AND i.id IS NULL
integrityChecks.detail: 0 孤立引用 → 实际: 0 孤立引用

integrityChecks.label: 时段预订一致性（isBooked=true 的时段有 matchId）
integrityChecks.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) as bad FROM venue_time_slots vts
      WHERE vts.is_booked = true AND vts.match_id IS NULL
integrityChecks.detail: 0 异常 → 实际: 0 异常

integrityChecks.label: 反馈评分范围 ∈ [-50, 50]
integrityChecks.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) as out_of_range FROM players p
      WHERE p.match_adjust_value < -50 OR p.match_adjust_value > 50
integrityChecks.detail: 0 越界 → 实际: 0 越界

integrityChecks.label: 乐观锁版本号 ≥ 1
integrityChecks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as bad FROM players p WHERE p.version < 1
integrityChecks.detail: 0 异常 → 实际: 0 异常

integrityChecks.label: 通知数量统计
integrityChecks.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total,
      COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as users_with_notifications
      FROM notifications
integrityChecks.detail: ≥ 0 条通知 → 实际: 0 条通知, 0 个用户
